name: Sucralose (Splenda)
siboNotes: Pure sucralose is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's not fermented by bacteria. However, some Splenda products contain bulking agents like maltodextrin which may cause issues in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use sparingly as sweetness is 600x stronger than sugar
Heat-stable for baking and cooking applications
Check ingredient labels as some Splenda products contain bulking agents
Start with small amounts to assess individual tolerance
nutritionalHighlights: No impact on blood sugar levels
Does not contribute to tooth decay
